content.title: YOUR DAILY HEALTH CHEAT SHEET {{NOBODY}} GAVE YOU
facts: **Sunlight** -> 15 min before noon -> Deeper sleep tonight
**Dark chocolate** -> 1 small square/day -> Lower stress hormones
**Journaling** -> 3 minutes before bed -> Quieter racing mind
**Deep breathing** -> 5 minutes/day -> Lower resting heart rate
**Power naps** -> 20 minutes max -> Sharper afternoon energy
**Follow along** – for more daily health tips like this.
content.caption:
A few of today's picks do more than they get credit for. Pumpkin seeds are loaded with magnesium and tryptophan, two compounds your brain uses to calm overactive stress signals and ease you into rest. Sardines bring a dose of omega-3s straight to your joints, helping reduce the low-grade inflammation that makes mornings feel stiffer than they should. And that short burst of sunlight before noon isn't just pleasant, it helps set your internal clock so your body knows when to release melatonin hours later, which is why it quietly improves sleep that same night. Everyone's body responds a little differently, so pay attention to what actually shifts for you.

This is what we do over at @smarthealthfix: we connect the dots between nutrition, common health complaints, your organs, and the tiny daily habits that influence all of it. Our mission is to help you build small, realistic routines instead of chasing quick fixes that never stick.
